name: – Leire Pajín, Aurelijus Veryga – Amendments by the committee responsible – separate vote – Am 53
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: (25a) An important area for cooperation between civilian and military authorities is ensuring timely access to and availability of medical countermeasures to enhance preparedness and response to CBRN, hybrid threats and armed conflicts, including novel biological and chemical agents for which no effective treatments currently exist.
